moments.label: Opening / Ambiguous Intent
moments.purpose: Prove how the world introduces AI Council without agent theater and makes uncertainty/product value legible immediately.
moments.productState: An ambiguous technical request has entered with project context, but no decision is yet justified.

moments.label: Problem / Strategy Comparison
moments.purpose: Prove how the world visualizes evidence, alternative formulations, hard constraints, candidate strategies, and disagreement without becoming a dashboard grid.
moments.productState: The real problem is being formulated and several strategies remain eligible or contested.

moments.label: Decision / Approval Boundary
moments.purpose: Prove the moment a decision earns governed commitment and show why approval is consequential rather than ceremonial.
moments.productState: A preferred strategy exists, but hard constraints, authority, evidence, and reversibility still govern whether it may become action.

moments.label: Execution / Verification / Memory
moments.purpose: Prove that the world survives after the decision: execution consequence, verification, rollback, and evidence-backed memory remain part of the same lineage.
moments.productState: An approved action has executed and the system must distinguish attempted work, verified result, and remembered project truth.

moments.label: Mobile / Decision Continuity
moments.purpose: Prove the world on a narrow screen without collapsing into chat, cards, or an unreadable miniature desktop.
moments.productState: The user resumes a consequential decision on mobile and must understand current state, blockers, authority, and next action.
